description: Defines FileType enum, file extension and MIME type mappings, utility functions for file type and extension conversions, and categorization of file types (images, videos, audio, text, and specific acceptance sets).

classes.name: FileType
classes.description: Enumeration of supported file types with string identifiers.

methods.name: get_file_extension_from_mime_type
methods.description: Returns the file extension associated with a given MIME type.

methods.name: get_file_type_from_extension
methods.description: Returns the FileType enum corresponding to a file extension.

methods.name: get_file_extension_for_file_type
methods.description: Returns the primary file extension for a given FileType.

methods.name: get_file_mime_type_for_file_type
methods.description: Returns the MIME type for a given FileType.

methods.name: get_file_mime_type_from_extension
methods.description: Returns the MIME type for a given file extension.

methods.name: is_image_file_type
methods.description: Checks if a FileType is an image.

methods.name: is_video_file_type
methods.description: Checks if a FileType is a video.

methods.name: is_audio_file_type
methods.description: Checks if a FileType is audio.

methods.name: is_text_file_type
methods.description: Checks if a FileType is text.

methods.name: is_gemini_1_5_accepted_file_type
methods.description: Checks if a FileType is accepted by Gemini 1.5.
